hero.name: Rariana Aina Andriamiadana
hero.subtitle: I design and build websites and web applications end to end for clients in France and worldwide: .NET and Java on the server, React and TypeScript on the front end, Supabase and Odoo when the project calls for it. Available for remote work.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: From business need to live application
about.description_1: As a freelance full stack developer, I build websites and web applications remotely for clients in France, such as the Harrys Studio booking site or the redesign of the Agentova.ai website. I cover the whole chain: requirements, data model, interface, go-live and ongoing updates.
about.description_2: At OPTIMADA, I evolved an HR application used by companies of 300 to 2,000 employees and took part in its migration to .NET and React, then built a customer portal in Spring Boot and React synchronized with Sage 100cloud CRM. At KASIA Consulting, I configured Odoo 19 and developed custom modules in Python.
about.description_3: Before development, I spent four years at Webhelp, first in technical support, then auditing access compliance on information systems. I kept the rigor, the service mindset and the habit of working to international clients' requirements.
